action_instruction: Checking whether a signed-in header state is present in the site header
intent: whether a signed-in header state for the attempted account is present in the site header

action_params.condition: 'a signed-in header state for the attempted account' does NOT appear.
action_params.query: whether a signed-in header state for the attempted account is present in the site header
action_params.code_js: (() => { const texts = [...el(1).querySelectorAll('a,button,[aria-label]')].map(n => (n.innerText || n.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().toLowerCase()); return texts.some(t => /sign out|log out|my account|profile|welcome|hello|hi[,!]?/.test(t)); })()

action_params.condition: Signing in with a correct email and a wrong password does not establish a signed-in session.
action_params.query: whether the site header still shows the Sign in entry instead of a signed-in session state
